lines.text: Herod the tetrarch heard the reports about Jesus and told his servants that Jesus was Elijah risen from the dead.
Herod arrested John and put him in prison because John said it was not lawful for Herod to have Herodias.
Herod wanted to kill John but was afraid of the people, who regarded John as a prophet.
On Herod's birthday Herodias's daughter danced, and Herod promised her whatever she asked, so she asked for John's head.
Herod was grieved but ordered John beheaded in the prison, and John's guards buried his body and told Jesus.
